specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the basic principles of Computer Science
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of basic principles of computer programming (using an appropriate structured programming language such as C, python, etc.)

(b) Describe programming tools (compiler/ interpreter, text editor, IDE, Debugger)
(c) Install and configure the selected programming language (compiler/ interpreter, text editor, IDE, Debugger)
(d) Use programming tools of selected programming language to write a program (compile/run and debug a simple program)

(f) Use syntax and constructs of the selected programming language to write programs branching
(g) Debugging computer programs

Demonstration: Guide students through demonstration to debug a program

Clearly can describe programming tools
